whilst-tending-to-the-bushes-during-the-.text: If the player chooses the 'tend-to' on a pollen-rich bush:

steps.text: You've been awarded [1 or 2] anima-infused bark.

whilst-tending-to-the-bushes-during-the-.text: If the player chooses the 'tend-to' on an unpollinated bush:

steps.text: You've been awarded [1 or 2] Anima-infused bark.

whilst-tending-to-the-bushes-during-the-.text: If the player chooses the 'tend-to' on a bush with no open flowers:

steps.text: There are no open, unpollinated flowers on this bush yet.

whilst-tending-to-the-bushes-during-the-.text: If the player exchanged pollen to both bushes at least once when the iteration ends:

steps.text: You took the pollen from this bush and should apply it to a bush with unpollinated flowers.
A bush as started producing fruit, well done!

whilst-tending-to-the-bushes-during-the-.text: If the player exchanges pollen to both pollinated bushes when the iteration ends:

steps.text: The bush is already fruiting and won't benefit from any more pollen.

whilst-tending-to-the-bushes-during-the-.text: If the player exchanged pollen to both bushes when the event ends:

steps.text: The bushes become dormant and the bees move on. You've helped make the forest a more diverse and beautiful place!

whilst-tending-to-the-bushes-during-the-.text: If the player has extra pollen after the event ends:

steps.text: You discard your left over pollen.
